assumptions.causal_goal: The goal is to causally disentangle overlap extent from overlap location / geometry.
assumptions.delay_mechanistic_goal: Under fixed mask identity (thus fixed area and location), delay is tested as a strength/time-evolution modulator rather than a direction-changing factor.
assumptions.forbidden_metrics: No effective overlap area, contribution-weighted area, B-map weighted area, or probe contribution weighting is used.
assumptions.raw_overlap_only: Only raw overlap area is used. Raw overlap area equals the number of True pixels in the probe-side mask.
assumptions.sample_construction: Samples are constructed directly from the probe by masking selected probe regions.
assumptions.scientific_test: The experiment tests whether overlap area primarily controls displacement magnitude, whether probe-side overlap location / geometry primarily controls displacement direction, and whether delay under fixed mask identity mainly modulates strength / time evolution rather than direction.
assumptions.synthetic_control_design: This is a synthetic control experiment.

scientific_conclusions: Area controls displacement magnitude under fixed location.
Location / geometry controls displacement direction under fixed area.
Delay under fixed mask identity mainly modulates strength / time evolution rather than direction.
scientific_statement: This synthetic control experiment tests whether area controls magnitude, location controls direction, and delay under fixed masks mainly modulates strength / time evolution.
